blocks.title: Privacy Preserving
blocks.content: Your deposit and withdrawal are cryptographically decoupled, ensuring untraceable transfers.

### zNEP17 Protocol
zNEP17 utilizes zk-SNARKs to construct an anonymous transaction pool. When you deposit, a secret commitment is generated. You can later withdraw by providing a Zero-Knowledge proof of that commitment without revealing your original depositing address.
